subject: Re: Redwood Demo Day — request for post-signup promo support
messages:
From: Drew Nolan <drew@orchardanalytics.com>

Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Demo Day — follow-up & attendee promo codes request

Hi Mateo,

Great to meet you on the Demo Day panel last week — really valuable discussion. We had a last-minute surge in signups after the event and want to give late registrants a small nudge to try Redwood. Specifically:

- We have ~150 total registrants; about 40 registered in the 48 hours after the event closed.
- Can Redwood provide single-use promo codes to give those late registrants an extended trial window (we typically offer a discount or 30 days)?

Ideal ask: 40 single-use promo codes that 1) add a 30-day trial extension or equivalent starter credits, and 2) expire 90 days after issuance. If there are limits on quantity or we need to convert to a fixed-credit pack, we can adjust.

Attached is the attendee CSV so you can see who signed up late. We’re ready to share final distribution details once you confirm.

Thanks — hope we can make a quick exception here; this cohort converts well for us.

Cheers,
Drew Nolan
Head of Partnerships
Orchard Analytics
Attachments: attendee_list_oct11.csv
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Demo Day — follow-up & attendee promo codes request

Hi Drew — great to hear from you and glad the panel drove late signups. Appreciate the attendee list.

Quick summary of what I can do fast:
- I can provision up to 30 single-use promo codes today that grant a 30-day extension (or an equivalent 1,000-credit starter pack) — this is on the edge of our standard promo allowance so I need a quick OK from ops.
- If you need all 40, I’ll escalate for a one-time exception and loop in Marissa for approval.
- Codes will be single-use, tracked by HubSpot campaign tag, and expire 90 days after issuance by default unless you want an earlier cutoff.

Next steps from my side: if you confirm the preferred model (30-day extension vs fixed-credit starter), I’ll put together the code list and a short terms excerpt to attach. If you can send a finalized distribution list (email + HubSpot contact IDs if available) I’ll match them when I create the single-use codes.

Looping in Marissa and Kimberly to confirm capacity and any billing/reconciliation notes.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Demo Day — follow-up & attendee promo codes request

Thanks for the tag, Mateo.

Background: We typically approve up to 30 single-use demo extension codes per event without exec sign-off. Anything above 30 needs a one-off marketing exception.

Approval notes / constraints:
- APPROVED: 30 single-use codes that either add a 30-day trial extension or a 1,000-credit starter pack — Mateo to confirm which with the customer.
- REQUIREMENTS: Attach HubSpot campaign tag "demo-day-oct2026" when provisioning; include campaign ID in the redemption report.
- RECONCILE: Finance needs the codes listed in CSV format with contact IDs for month-end reconciliation. Use the promo_codes_template.csv schema.
- TERMS: All codes must include our standard promo terms excerpt (no refunds; single-use; non-transferable).

Kimberly — please help finalize the code export and attach the terms PDF. Mateo — once codes are created, send the CSV to Drew and mark the HubSpot campaign.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachments: promo_codes_template.csv, promo_terms_excerpt.pdf
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Hi Drew — quick update and confirmed plan.

1) What we’ll issue: 30 single-use promo codes (single redemption) that grant a 30-day trial extension — provisioned today.
2) Expiration: Codes will expire on 2027-01-15 (90 days from issuance).
3) Delivery: I attached the code CSV (orchard_30_codes.csv) and our promo terms (redwood_promo_terms.pdf). We tagged the campaign in HubSpot as "demo-day-oct2026" and included campaign ID 67890.

Next steps for you: share the final distribution list (email + HubSpot contact ID) so we can reconcile usage. If you still want the additional 10 codes after you see redemptions, reply and we’ll route for a one-time exception.

Thanks — excited to get your late cohort live.

Best,
